topics.name: SPM Implementation Overview
topics.description: Understand the Strategic Portfolio Management implementation approach and key configuration decisions.

introduction.overview: Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) provides organizations with tools to manage ideas, demands, projects, and resources in alignment with business strategy. Understanding the implementation approach is essential for success.
introduction.whyItMatters: Implementation Overview covers 2% of the CIS-SPM exam. While small, this foundational knowledge helps contextualize other SPM topics.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand SPM components, implementation phases, and key stakeholder roles. Know the relationship between SPM and other ServiceNow applications.
introduction.examTips: Focus on understanding how SPM modules work together. Know the basic implementation sequence and dependencies.

topics.name: Idea and Demand
topics.description: Configure and manage the intake process for ideas and demands, including assessment and prioritization.

introduction.overview: Ideas and Demands represent the intake mechanism for potential work. Ideas capture innovation proposals while Demands represent work requests that need assessment before becoming projects.
introduction.whyItMatters: Idea and Demand covers 18% of the CIS-SPM exam. This is the entry point for work into the SPM system.
introduction.keyConcepts: Master the idea submission and assessment workflow, understand demand management configuration, and know how items progress to projects.
introduction.examTips: Know the difference between ideas and demands. Understand the assessment process and criteria. Focus on the workflow from submission to project creation.

topics.name: Project Management
topics.description: Master project creation, planning, execution, and monitoring within the SPM framework.

introduction.overview: Project Management in SPM provides comprehensive tools for planning, executing, and tracking projects. It includes task management, milestone tracking, and integration with resource and financial management.
introduction.whyItMatters: Project Management is the largest domain at 30% of the CIS-SPM exam. This reflects its central role in SPM.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand project templates, WBS creation, task dependencies, and project status tracking. Know how projects integrate with resource and financial management.
introduction.examTips: Focus on project creation methods, task management, and status reporting. Know how to use the project workbench and understand project health indicators.

topics.name: Resource Management
topics.description: Configure and manage resource allocation, capacity planning, and team assignments across projects.

introduction.overview: Resource Management ensures the right people are assigned to the right work at the right time. It includes capacity planning, allocation, and utilization tracking.
introduction.whyItMatters: Resource Management covers 23% of the CIS-SPM exam. Effective resource management is critical for project success.
introduction.keyConcepts: Master resource pools, allocation methods, and capacity planning. Understand how to manage over/under allocation and resource conflicts.
introduction.examTips: Focus on resource allocation mechanisms, capacity calculations, and conflict resolution. Know the different allocation methods and when to use each.

topics.name: Timecard Management
topics.description: Configure timecard submission, approval workflows, and integration with project and resource tracking.

introduction.overview: Timecard Management captures actual time spent on tasks and projects, enabling accurate tracking of effort and costs.
introduction.whyItMatters: Timecard Management covers 5% of the CIS-SPM exam. While smaller, it's essential for accurate project tracking and billing.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand timecard configuration, approval workflows, and how timecards feed into project actuals and financial tracking.
introduction.examTips: Know the timecard submission process and approval configuration. Understand how timecards update project actuals.

topics.name: SPM Financials
topics.description: Configure financial management including budgets, costs, benefits tracking, and ROI calculations.

introduction.overview: SPM Financials provides tools for managing project and portfolio budgets, tracking costs, and calculating return on investment.
introduction.whyItMatters: SPM Financials covers 10% of the CIS-SPM exam. Financial management is essential for strategic decision-making.
introduction.keyConcepts: Master budget configuration, cost tracking methods, and benefit realization. Understand how financials roll up from projects to portfolios.
introduction.examTips: Focus on budget vs actual tracking, cost breakdown structures, and benefit tracking. Know how to configure financial plans and reports.

topics.name: Portfolio Planning Workspace
topics.description: Use the Portfolio Planning Workspace to visualize, analyze, and optimize project portfolios.

introduction.overview: The Portfolio Planning Workspace provides visual tools for portfolio analysis, scenario planning, and optimization based on constraints and priorities.
introduction.whyItMatters: Portfolio Planning Workspace covers 8% of the CIS-SPM exam. This workspace is key for strategic portfolio decisions.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand workspace features including bubble charts, scenario comparison, and optimization tools. Know how to configure portfolio views.
introduction.examTips: Focus on the portfolio visualization tools and how to interpret them. Know how to create and compare scenarios for portfolio planning.

topics.name: SPM Platform Analytics & Dashboards
topics.description: Configure and use SPM dashboards and analytics for portfolio and project performance monitoring.

introduction.overview: SPM includes pre-built dashboards and Performance Analytics indicators for monitoring portfolio and project health, resource utilization, and financial performance.
introduction.whyItMatters: Platform Analytics covers 2% of the CIS-SPM exam. Understanding available dashboards helps communicate project status.
introduction.keyConcepts: Know the out-of-box SPM dashboards, understand key performance indicators, and learn how to customize views for different audiences.
introduction.examTips: Focus on the standard SPM dashboards and what metrics they display. Know how to interpret portfolio health indicators.

topics.name: SPM Better Together
topics.description: Understand how SPM integrates with other ServiceNow applications for enhanced capabilities.

introduction.overview: SPM integrates with other ServiceNow applications like ITSM, ITOM, and GRC to provide a connected view of work across the organization.
introduction.whyItMatters: SPM Better Together covers 2% of the CIS-SPM exam. Understanding integrations helps maximize SPM value.
introduction.keyConcepts: Know the key integrations including Change Management, CMDB, and GRC. Understand how SPM can manage IT and business projects together.
introduction.examTips: Focus on common integration scenarios and the benefits of connecting SPM with other ServiceNow applications.
